about: Package 8 (the picker, the popover, tooltips, touch, the focus ring, the keys that walk the desk, drag and drop): every scenario this package makes runnable, each with what it exercises. Concept scenarios that exercise these features but also need a part a later package draws are listed as waiting on that package. 33-overlays.mjs holds on the concept page too (--page hotstep-tiers.html: all pass there): each of its scenarios is a concept scenario's own checks with the steps that need another package's part replaced by parts both pages draw, so that every feature here is caught by a scenario that runs today (switches.mjs leaves waiting scenarios out). `excluded` lists the concept's scenarios that touch these features and are left out, each with the reason.

scenarios.why: A Lab module added from a card outside Lab offers Lab in the popover; Not now closes it; Switch to Lab and add it; added with no anchor, a toast (labOffer, adding.ts).
A Modules card dropped on the desk lands at the place nearest the pointer; a cancelled drag adds nothing and leaves nothing behind (dnd.tsx).
A picker drawing dropped on the desk is added and the picker closes; a pedal brings the Pedalboard, a second joins in chain order, a side unit too.
A tile dragged by its header moves; a cancelled move puts it back.

waiting.because: Its second check reads the workflow's changed mark (S.wfDirty), which the workflows package keeps; the move and the cancel are checked in 33-overlays/drag-moves-a-tile-and-cancels.

scenarios.why: The picker: its button and F9, the filter and its count, Enter, Escape, the category bar, the arrows, Home, End, Tab, Space, a Lab module's offer, one already on the desk, pointing, ×, the backdrop, F9 toggling.

waiting.because: Its Ctrl+Enter check reads the generation queue (S.songs), which the generation package keeps; every other check is in 33-overlays/picker-opens-filters-walks-and-adds.

scenarios.why: The keyboard focus ring on Tab, a keyboard tip, Escape hides it, a pointer press turns the ring off, a pointer-focused knob shows none until an arrow.

waiting.because: It starts in the prompt (package 4) and ends on a workflow row (package 7); its ring and tip checks are in 33-overlays/focus-ring-and-keyboard-tips.

scenarios.why: Pressing and holding a control under a finger shows its tip, which goes by itself.

waiting.because: It holds the seed manager's roll button ([data-seedrand]), which the Seed module's package draws; the same is checked on the save state in 33-overlays/a-held-finger-shows-the-tip-and-still-presses.

scenarios.why: A resting pointer gets the page's tip and the browser's is held back; it goes when the pointer leaves and the title comes back.

waiting.because: It points at the Workflows panel's import button (#importBtn), which the workflows package draws; the same is checked on the save state in 33-overlays/hover-tip-holds-the-title-back.

scenarios.why: A press on a grip offers the four moves in the popover (B-23); Move to the top; Undo puts it back (grip-menu.tsx).
The preview stands at the place nearest the pointer and the drop lands exactly where it stood; a drop that changed the order is one step; reading order is the order (Q-01, L-01).
The same at 1440.
The same at Lab, 1280.
The same at Quick.
A tip opens clear of the control's read-outs: the reels' LCD and cost line, a knob's value (L-06).

waiting.because: It points at the Takes module's reels (.reel2), which that module's package draws; the knob's half is checked in 33-overlays/knob-tip-waits-and-keeps-off-its-value.

scenarios.why: Under a finger a swipe that starts on a control scrolls and leaves it alone; resting first turns a knob; a sideways drag moves a ruler; each touch edit one step (S-29).

waiting.because: It sets its desk by loading the factory workflow Everything (loadPreset), which the workflows package builds; the same is checked on a desk set by the scene in 33-overlays/a-swipe-scrolls-and-a-rest-turns.

scenarios.why: F6 enters the desk at its first module, each press the next in reading order, Shift+F6 back (S-33).

waiting.because: It loads the factory workflow Everything (package 7) and starts in the prompt (package 4); the same is checked from the tier switch in 33-overlays/f6-walks-the-desk.

scenarios.why: The sentence splitter keeps every digit; the VRAM meter's tip says 31.8 GB; every title on a full Lab desk splits with nothing lost (F-01, Q-01, E-04).
A control held under a finger shows its tip and is still pressed when the finger lifts: Generate, a tier (S-01).

waiting.because: It holds Generate (package 6) after typing in the prompt (package 4); the tier half is checked in 33-overlays/a-held-finger-shows-the-tip-and-still-presses.

scenarios.why: A drop scrolls nothing, and the tile stands where its preview stood (Q-15).
The preview is the tile's own face, the size it lands at; after the drag one tile carries its name (L-26).

The same at 1600x900.

Pending (S-36) in the concept, right here: the first vertical swipe that starts on a knob scrolls, and one toast says to rest a finger first.
07-overlays-keys/picker's checks without the generation queue; and Ctrl+Z under the picker undoes nothing and says so.
A tile dragged by its header moves, one step; a cancelled move puts it back; a cancelled pedal drag adds nothing and leaves nothing glowing.
The popover from a card: focus on its first choice, Escape gives focus back to the card, Tab past its last button closes it, a click outside closes it.
The ring on Tab, the keyboard tip with every digit, Escape, a pointer press, a pointer-focused knob and its first arrow (M-09, G-B-04).
The page's tip after a rest, the browser's held back, the title given back when the pointer leaves (C-31).
A tip due inside the quiet after a press waits for it (L-06), and opens clear of the knob's value.
An idle pedal's LED: its tip opens clear of everything the pedal reads out (L-06).
A held finger shows the tip, which goes by itself; a tier held 0.8 s is still chosen (S-01).
Swipes that start on a knob, a ruler, a number box or a pad change nothing; a rest then a drag turns the knob; a sideways drag moves the ruler; each one step (S-29).
F6 enters the desk, walks it in reading order, Shift+F6 back; not while the picker is open (S-33).

excluded.why: It rests on the Sampler's AUTO pill for Shift ([data-auto="samp.shift"]), which no part draws yet (the knob's auto pill); the quiet it checks is in 33-overlays/knob-tip-waits-and-keeps-off-its-value.

Only its last check (Open the picker from the empty desk) is this package's, and it passes; the rest needs Quick's fold of modules and the concept's defineModule, which the rebuild has no counterpart for. The picker's button is in 33-overlays/picker-opens-filters-walks-and-adds.
It types in the prompt (package 4) and opens the Concept notes (no package draws them yet); Ctrl+Z under the picker is in 33-overlays/picker-opens-filters-walks-and-adds.
It loads a workflow (package 7) and opens the presets popover (package 4) and the notes.
Pending (S-17): the toast's claim on Tab (the toast's package, 6) inside the drafts popover (package 6 or 7).
The Concept notes and the engine log are not this package's; Escape closing only the top layer is in 33-overlays/lab-offer-popover-keys and the picker's scenarios.
